description.value: This study investigated metabolic, structural, and diffusion-related brain changes in patients with torture-related post-traumatic stress disorder compared with healthy volunteers using MRI, diffusion-weighted imaging, and 18F-FDG PET.
The study was prospective and cross-sectional, comparing 9 patients with TR-PTSD with 10 healthy volunteers; all subjects were currently unmedicated.
